description: Retrieve one file (optionally verify prompt ownership) to disk or base64, or all outputs of a prompt into a directory. source.kind=file requires destination.kind=file/base64; source.kind=prompt requires directory. Single images support format conversion. Requires COMFYUI_HOST; disk destinations may overwrite files.

destination.description: Disk file, directory, or inline base64

filename.description: Filename returned by list_outputs or get_history

node_id.description: Optional output node filter; requires prompt_id

prompt_id.description: When provided, verify this file belongs to the prompt

type.description: Storage type; resolved from prompt metadata when verifying ownership, otherwise defaults to output

source.description: Single file or every output of a prompt

name: download_outputs
